# gunit

> A Godot 4 embedded unit testing framework (plugin) supporting GDScript.

gunit v7.0.0 — supports Godot 4.7–4.8. The framework is self-tested: it uses itself to run its own test suite. The plugin lives entirely under `addons/gunit/`.

**License:** MIT

Keywords: Godot unit testing, GDScript testing framework, Godot 4 plugin, game testing, test-driven development, TDD, automated testing, unit test, integration test, scene testing, signal testing, mock, spy, stub, fuzzing, parameterized tests, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, JUnit XML, HTML report

## Why gunit

gunit is a feature-rich testing framework for Godot 4, designed to make writing and running tests enjoyable for Godot developers.

- **GDScript support** — write tests in the same language as your game code
- **Fluent assertion API** — chainable, type-aware assertions with descriptive failure messages
- **Full mock/stub/spy support** — isolate dependencies and verify interactions
- **Scene Runner** — simulate user input (keyboard, mouse, actions) on live nodes/UI in tests
- **Signal assertions** — await and assert signal emissions with timeout support
- **Fuzzing / parameterized tests** — data-driven test cases with built-in fuzzers
- **CI/CD ready** — JUnit XML and HTML reports, headless mode, GitHub Actions integration
- **Godot editor integration** — Test Inspector panel with run/re-run, green/red tree, filtering
- **Test hooks** — `before`/`after` (suite-level) and `before_test`/`after_test` (per-test) setup and teardown callbacks
- **Session hooks** — global setup and teardown logic that runs once per test session via `GdUnitTestSessionHook`
- **Integrated update tool** — check for and install new releases directly from the Godot editor
- **Asset Library** — installable directly from the Godot Editor Asset Library

## Installation

**Via Godot Asset Library** (recommended): Search for "gunit" in the Godot Editor → AssetLib tab.

**Via release download**: Download the latest `.zip` from [GitHub releases](https://github.com/uvw327/gunit/releases), extract into your project's `addons/` folder, then enable the plugin in *Project → Project Settings → Plugins*.

## Quick Start (GDScript)

```gdscript
extends GdUnitTestSuite


func test_string_contains() -> void:
    assert_str("Hello gunit").contains("gunit")


func test_array_has_size() -> void:
    assert_array([1, 2, 3]).has_size(3).contains(1, 2)


func test_signal_emitted() -> void:
    var timer := auto_free(Timer.new())
    add_child(timer)
    timer.start(0.1)
    await assert_signal(timer).is_emitted("timeout")


func test_mock_example() -> void:
    var mock_node := mock(Node)
    mock_node.get_name()
    verify(mock_node).get_name()


func test_scene_runner() -> void:
    # load a scene and wrap it in a runner
    var runner := scene_runner("res://scenes/MyGame.tscn")
    # simulate a key press and advance frames
    runner.simulate_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE)
    await runner.simulate_frames(30)
    # assert expected scene state
    assert_object(runner.find_child("Player")).is_not_null()
```

## About

gunit is a personal, GDScript-only fork of **[gdUnit4](https://github.com/MikeSchulze/gdUnit4)** by Mike Schulze (MIT license), maintained at **[github.com/uvw327/gunit](https://github.com/uvw327/gunit)**. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the upstream project.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://godot-gdunit-labs.github.io/gdUnit4/latest/): Upstream full reference — assertions, mocking, spying, scene runner, fuzzing, CI setup (the fork keeps the upstream GDScript API)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/uvw327/gunit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines
- Upstream community: [Discord server](https://discord.gg/rdq36JwuaJ) · [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/GodotGdUnitLabs)

## Running Tests (CLI)

```bash
# Set Godot binary, then run all tests
export GODOT_BIN=/path/to/godot
./addons/gunit/runtest.sh

# Run a specific path
./addons/gunit/runtest.sh --godot_binary /path/to/godot -a res://addons/gunit/test/asserts/
```

## Plugin Structure

```
addons/gunit/
├── plugin.cfg          # Plugin metadata and version
├── plugin.gd           # EditorPlugin entry point
├── bin/                # CLI tools (GdUnitCmdTool.gd, GdUnitCopyLog.gd)
├── src/                # All framework source code
└── test/               # Self-tests (mirrors src/ structure)
```

For full source module breakdown, coding conventions, and contributor guidelines see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).
